items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: And then Peter Patton used to play banjo and then Marrero boys one named Lowndes he playing bass.

ctx.x: He had a whole drum set playing.
The drum set in that kazooke in his mouth. If we wouldn't have been there, it would have been Peter.
What kind of trombone were you playing then? Was that the con that you were playing then? Yeah. You bought it here in town?
